verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only marketing-level transcription claims: automatic transcription, multiple languages, speaker recognition and team vocabulary. Nothing documents which models are used, any accuracy figures or benchmarks, or known limitations, which is the transparency this story asks for. Community anecdotes about accuracy (good with poor connections, weaker on varied accents, occasional bad mis-transcriptions) are user reports, not vendor documentation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, the vendor documents how transcription actually works and its quality (models, accuracy claims, known limits) rather than just saying "AI-powered"
